newsitem.title: USA: Yeltsin walks, recovering well from heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin walks, recovering well from heart surgery.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin walked on Thursday for the first time after his open heart surgery but doctors advised him to stay another 24 hours in the Cardiology Research Centre, a Kremlin spokesman said.

Presidential press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky, announcing details of a doctors' report after Yeltsin's quintuple bypass operation two days ago, made clear the 65-year-old president was recovering normally.
"The patient is active, can sit and stand up, walks in his ward," he told reporters, quoting doctors who discussed Yeltsin's progress for 90 minutes on Thursday morning after he had been examined.
"The planned council, in which foreign doctors participated, decided that the president should stay in the cardiology centre for another day."
U.S. heart surgeon Michael DeBakey, who was a consultant at the operation, said Yeltsin could be back at home in two to three weeks.
He said the president was recovering rapidly and would become a "new man". "You're going to see a vigorous leader," he said.
